description: Read the interactive controls of a shared tab (links, buttons, fields, labels). Form values are never included, hidden controls are excluded, and the list can be truncated (see coverage). With claim=true (default) it also takes the write claim, so the returned refs can be acted on; refs from earlier snapshots become stale. Sign-in/code/payment fields are marked CREDENTIAL and must be filled by the user.

browser_instance_id.description: Only needed when several Firefox profiles are connected.

claim.description: Take the write claim so refs can be used with click/fill/type/key. Default true. Use false for a read-only look.

context_id.description: Context id from browser_contexts, for example tab:12.

name: browser_snapshot
title: Snapshot a shared tab
